verdict.rationale: Sketch offers an official vanilla JavaScript API (fully supported between releases), a plugin system (skpm), sketchtool CLI, and a documented MCP server for AI clients to integrate with Sketch — these are legitimate official SDKs/interfaces for building against. However, no traditional REST/OpenAPI SDK exists (probe confirms openapi.json 404s), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of developers building production integrations against these APIs. missing for 10: independent verification of SDK robustness/versioning stability, a formal REST/OpenAPI-based SDK, and third-party developer testimonials confirming ease of building against the APIs.
